title: Read durable activation binding by attempt
description: Prerequisite for task-00e4827dd9374ec79625351d560c82c8. ProviderRunRecord carries attempt/effect/epoch but no session, so a provider reader cannot prove authenticated session binding from opaque request bytes. Land a read-only, horizon-bounded production lookup that selects the unique decision-verified Foundation activation by projectId+attemptId and returns its aggregate, effect, epoch, and owner session without changing the 371-line activation-ledger reader.
definitionOfDone: A read-only `readFoundationActivationByAttempt`-style surface accepts only projectId and attemptId, captures one store horizon, and uses the existing activation event-type index plus `readFoundationActivationHistory` to return a deeply frozen unique binding containing activationAggregateId, attemptId, effectIntentId, epoch, ownerSessionRef, projectId, and activationDigest.

Every candidate is receipt/decision/project/canonical-history verified before selection; zero candidates is the existing exact NOT_FOUND/ABSENT answer, more than one is EVIDENCE_AMBIGUOUS, and unreadable, malformed, foreign-project, or identity-disagreeing evidence preserves the existing FOUNDATION_ACTIVATION_BINDING code/layer rather than being selected by order.

The scan is bounded by its captured horizon and explicit page/case ceilings, never scans all event types, never picks the highest epoch, and returns UNKNOWN rather than partial authority on cursor drift, malformed pages, store throws, or a writer racing beyond the horizon.

Real SqliteEventStore tests seed only through the production activation writer and cover accepted, absent, duplicate, foreign, malformed/unreadable, and cross-page/racing cases with exact code/layer, raw counts, a positive generated-case count, and no writes by the reader.
Mutation drills that choose the first duplicate or skip production history validation redden named assertions; completion names task-00e4827dd9374ec79625351d560c82c8 as consumer.

implementationPlan.description: TDD RED — ACCEPTED, ABSENT, AND READ-ONLY PROOF in the new activation-attempt-reader.test.ts. Build file-backed project-bound SqliteEventStore fixtures with `openHarnessStore` + `seedReadyProject`, and generate every accepted activation only by a parameterized request passed through production `runEffectActivateCommand`; never use `activation-ledger-fixtures.record()`, whose grant is codec-legal but activation-incoherent. Keep principalId deliberately different from lease.ownerSessionRef. Pin `readFoundationActivationByAttempt(store, projectId, attemptId)` to exactly three arguments after the store—no caller session/effect/epoch/limit. One accepted control must assert the exact deeply frozen own-key result `{status:"BOUND", activationAggregateId, attemptId, effectIntentId, epoch: parsed durable lease.epoch, ownerSessionRef, projectId, activationDigest}`; also assert repeated unchanged reads serialize identically. The absence control must contain at least one other valid activation so an always-NOT_FOUND implementation cannot pass, and must equal the existing exact `{status:"ABSENT", code:"FOUNDATION_BINDING_NOT_FOUND", layer:"FOUNDATION_ACTIVATION_BINDING"}`. Around every non-race read, snapshot positive raw event horizon/count, command-decision page/count, relevant aggregate versions/receipts, and database bytes/mtime, then assert the reader changed none of them. Capture the intended RED from the missing module rather than adding a test helper that answers the query.

implementationPlan.description: TDD RED — UNIQUENESS, PROVENANCE, BOUNDS, AND RACES in the same test. Seed 102 distinct valid activations through `runEffectActivateCommand`: 99 unrelated; two different activation aggregates sharing the queried attemptId at positions 100/101; then one unique page-2 target. Assert the duplicate query scans past the first hit and answers exact UNKNOWN/`FOUNDATION_BINDING_EVIDENCE_AMBIGUOUS`, while the unique page-2 query is BOUND and the indexed page-call count is >=2. Add a nonempty generated hostile table implemented only as thin read-only decorators over that real seeded store: invalid query; health or trace foreign project; malformed page/items/cursor/type; indexed-vs-history/canonical-history disagreement; missing and readable-wrong decision/receipt, wrong exported command kind, target/version/event/result/hash linkage; malformed leases; activation-digest disagreement; and thrown `DurableStoreError` plus generic throws. Pin the exact map at `FOUNDATION_ACTIVATION_BINDING`: QUERY_INVALID, PROJECT_MISMATCH, EVIDENCE_MALFORMED (preserving history AMBIGUOUS), ACTIVATION_INCOHERENT for readable receipt/decision/lease/activation identity disagreement, EVIDENCE_UNREADABLE for missing/throws, and SCAN_INCOMPLETE for page/cursor/ceiling/horizon faults. Every UNKNOWN arm must assert mandatory `storeCode` (exact DurableStoreError.code, otherwise null); ABSENT retains its existing byte shape. Test the literal preview ceilings—page size 100, at most 64 pages and 6,400 candidates—with a bounded decorator generated from a real nonmatching seed; assert a positive generated count and that crossing either ceiling returns SCAN_INCOMPLETE with zero authority. For the real race, copy the repository's proven Windows-safe data-URL Worker + SharedArrayBuffer/Atomics pattern: after the reader captures H, a second store handle invokes real `runEffectActivateCommand`, closes before signaling, and the parent continues. Any indexed event/history beyond H or a final horizon different from H must answer SCAN_INCOMPLETE. Snapshot counts after the intentional worker commit but before the reader resumes, then prove the reader adds nothing; await/terminate the worker and close all SQLite handles before recursive temp cleanup.

MINIMUM IMPLEMENTATION — READ PORT, RESULT SHAPES, AND BOUNDED WALK in activation-attempt-reader.ts (<250 physical lines). Define an exported read-only structural port containing only `getHealth`, `readEventHorizon`, `readEventsByTypeAfter`, `readEvents`, `getCommandDecision`, and `getCommandReceipt`; no commit/apply, raw DatabaseSync, unfiltered readEventsAfter, caller callback, or clock. Define the BOUND primitive-only result and a local failure union: return `foundationBindingAbsent` unchanged for NOT_FOUND; for UNKNOWN spread the existing `foundationBindingUnknown(code)` into one newly frozen object with mandatory `storeCode: DurableStoreErrorCode|null`, populated only from public `DurableStoreError.code` and never an error message. Validate projectId/attemptId with production `isQueryText`, verify `getHealth().projectId`, capture one authoritative H, then page only exported ACTIVATION_LEDGER_EVENT_TYPE using PAGE_SIZE=100, MAX_SCAN_PAGES=64 and MAX_SCAN_CANDIDATES=6_400. Require a well-shaped page, <=100 items, strict increasing bigint positions, exact filtered event type, nonempty progress when hasMore, nextCursor equal to the last served position (or null on a terminal empty page), and no page/candidate beyond either ceiling. Any event position >H or changed final `readEventHorizon()` is SCAN_INCOMPLETE; a store throw is EVIDENCE_UNREADABLE with upstream storeCode. Scan to bounded exhaustion, never early-return or pick a highest epoch.

MINIMUM IMPLEMENTATION — VERIFY EVERY CANDIDATE BEFORE FILTERING. For each indexed activation at or below H, first verify its decisionTrace project and exported command kind. Look up the command decision by the trace key `{commandId: trace.commandId, principalId, projectId}` but the receipt by the store-internal `event.commandId`—never swap them. Require decision EFFECTS_COMMITTED, command kind, key, target aggregate, expected/observed/previous/current versions 0/0/0/1, singleton business event id, empty outbox, resultBytes byte-equal to the indexed payload, and decision.requestSha256 equal to trace.requestSha256. Separately require receipt command/aggregate, versions 0->1, singleton event id, empty outbox, committedAt, and effectSha256 equal to the decision; receipt.requestSha256 must equal `event.requestSha256`, NOT the decision/trace request hash because those are distinct digest domains. Read the full aggregate, refuse any history event beyond H, require its sequence-1 event byte/identity-equal to the indexed candidate, and delegate all lifecycle/tail semantics to production `readFoundationActivationHistory`, returning its exact refusal unchanged except for the new UNKNOWN storeCode shape. Parse both record.lease and effectIntent.leaseBinding with public `parseLeaseRecord`, require `sameLease`, then require public `validateActivationCommit` COHERENT with exact activationDigest. Only after all checks compare the durable `record.attempt.attemptId`. Keep scanning after a hit; zero verified matches returns exact NOT_FOUND, a second matching aggregate returns EVIDENCE_AMBIGUOUS, and exactly one returns the frozen durable primitive binding. Add only the exact LF bridge bytes `export * from "./activation-attempt-reader.ts";\n`; no barrel or producer edit.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: 1) Extend the existing 371-line activation-ledger-reader.ts. Rejected by the task rail and because it is already beyond the 250 target; the new attempt index/provenance concern belongs in a focused sibling. 2) Scan all global events. Rejected: the store already ships an indexed exact event-type read and task/architecture forbid lifetime-growing global scans. 3) Select the first or highest-epoch match. Rejected: no durable current pointer exists and the DoD requires ambiguity, not order-based authority. 4) Trust opaque requestBytes, FoundationAttemptRecorded, or caller session/effect/epoch. Rejected: none proves the activation's authenticated lease owner; only the decision-verified activation does. 5) Verify only the activation codec/history. Rejected: a self-consistent foreign command or missing receipt could still mint activation-shaped bytes; prerequisite cc3c exists precisely so command kind, decision and receipt can all be proven. 6) Compare every SHA field to one value. Rejected: decision/trace request identity and event/receipt effect request identity are intentionally different domains. 7) Use hand-built activation-ledger fixtures for accepted cases. Rejected: their grant is codec-legal but fails production `validateActivationCommit`; accepted authority must be produced through `runEffectActivateCommand`. 8) Chosen: a three-file, read-only indexed projection that validates every candidate before attempt filtering, captures H, scans to explicit preview ceilings, and fails closed on drift.

planningNotes.risks: The production module is line-tight: estimated 220–245 lines. Keep helpers compact and split only if it would cross 250; do not spill into the 249-line contracts file or 371-line reader. The biggest correctness risk is filtering on attemptId before verifying unrelated candidates—a malformed second row would then be ignored and partial authority returned. Another is early return after the first page/hit, which misses a boundary duplicate. A third is crossing the two request-SHA domains or using trace.commandId for the receipt. A fourth is treating a concurrent post-H tail as current history; any indexed/history position >H plus final horizon drift must fail UNKNOWN. A fifth is a fake race: same-isolate timers cannot run during this synchronous reader, so use the repository's Worker/Atomics pattern and close handles before Windows cleanup. A sixth is a refusal-only suite; the accepted frozen control, page-2 accepted target, positive seeds/cases and raw no-write counts prevent refuse-all. The local mandatory storeCode extension is the only honest way to satisfy the rail because existing FoundationBindingResult has no storeCode; it adds no reason code or layer.
